Startup Founder

LinkedIn Spotlight Ads are a dynamic desktop ad format that personalizes the creative by pulling the member's profile photo and placing it alongside your brand logo. Lovart helps you create the custom background image that ties these elements together.
Can I use my brand's specific hex colors?
Yes. You can specify your brand's exact hex color codes in the prompt, and Lovart's reasoning engine will incorporate them into the background design, ensuring strict brand consistency.
Does Lovart generate the text for the ad too?

Lovart focuses on the visual design. While it can generate text concepts, for Spotlight Ads, the text is dynamic (configured in LinkedIn Campaign Manager). Lovart ensures the background image leaves appropriate negative space so your dynamic text is legible.
How quickly can I generate A/B test variations?

Instantly. Once you have a base design you like, you can ask the agent to 'generate 4 variations with different lighting' or 'make it more abstract,' giving you a folder full of testable assets in minutes.
Are the images high enough resolution for LinkedIn?
Absolutely. Lovart exports high-resolution images that meet or exceed LinkedIn's specifications (typically 300x250 or bespoke background sizes), ensuring your ads look crisp on all desktop screens.
